label: Search result sort configuration
type: the object controlling result ordering for a Search query. Default: score, descending. Missing sort-field values default to sorting last, unless explicitly set to sort first.
evidence: FTS sorting is sorted by descending order of relevance. It can, however, be customized to sort by different fields, depending on the application.
The value of missing can be first, in which case results with missing values appear before other results; or last (the default), in which case they appear after.
relates_to_competency_question: How does a Search query order its results by default, and what happens to documents missing the sort field?
